## Requirements
Requirement ids to satisfy + stamp: **R-2.2.2** (§5a.2 — the effect & transaction model)
and **R-2.2.3⁰ᵃ** (§5a.3 — the Stage-1 C0 slice: checkpoint view, `restore` per scope,
writer takeover, `retry_due` recomputation).

R-2.2.2 landed surface: the twelve-phase lifecycle as typed ledger events with the state
machine enforced at `append`; the `deferred` schema (`prepared → deferred → committed |
refused{branch_discarded}`, never committed inside the branch as a *phase-gated* state —
full branch semantics land with R-2.2.4⁰ᵃ at Stage 2); write-ahead `committed` (I-1:
`authorized ≺ committed ≺ action.tool.started` enforced at the ledger; `CommitToken`
checked at the helper seam → `NotCommitted`); `unknown` + `probe` (`probed{verdict}` —
`applied`/`not_applied` ARE the `observed` transition (I-4), `undeterminable` returns to
`unknown` with `probe_count + 1`); `not_applied` is *attempt*-terminal and
*effect*-terminal only when the class forecloses retry — `irreversible`, or
non-`idempotent` without a `not_applied` probe — a retryable `not_applied` keeps the
scope open for `committed{attempt_no + 1}` under the same key (invariant 4; ADR-0238 §1); writer-lease fencing inherited as the payload `fencing_token`
on every post-`prepared` phase (checked against the live generation at append); the
effect risk class `{reversibility, repeat_safety, scope}` as a *projection* of declared
`EffectAttributes` with `effective = max_by_danger(kernel_assessed, declared)` and
`unknown ⇒ {irreversible, non_idempotent, external}`; the ledger-derived idempotency
key `H(run_id, effect_id, canonical(args), capability_version)`; the per-class delivery
table (redispatch-from-`unknown` gate: `idempotent` or `probe = not_applied`, never for
`irreversible`); `compensated`/`reverted`/`abandoned` terminals.

R-2.2.3⁰ᵃ landed surface: `checkpoint_view` as a `project` view kind (never a second
store; materializable blob yields the same `view_hash`); `restore(run, holder, mode)`
executing the normative recovery table over the Stage-1 scope set
{`effect`, `model_call`, `tool_call`, `turn`, `permission`} (`context_assembly` is pure —
discard, no record); exactly one `lifecycle.run.resumed{from_seq, lease, recovery_decision,
holder, cause}`; every executed `RecoveryAction` ledgered under the new generation;
writer takeover via generation fencing + expiry; `retry_due(now)` recomputed from durable
`control.retry.scheduled` with `skipped{scope_closed}` for terminated scopes.

Spec-staged later (NOT this ticket): `verify_environment`/`verify_resume`, detached
reconciliation, `preserve_until`, HLC on continuation/child runs, `suspend`, wakeup
subscriptions/occurrence/claim/fire, effect/resource/environment/wakeup leases,
`HealingPolicy`, `compensate_run` (C1 saga coordinator), the KP battery (Stage 3),
hosted status mapping (C2/Stage 4).

## Acceptance criteria (gating, deterministic)
- **AC-R-2.2.2-3** (no dangling intent): after simulated cancel/timeout/crash, the
  rebuilt projection has a terminal or `unknown` record for every `intended` effect —
  restore marks `committed`/`prepared`-non-`read_only` `unknown{worker_lost}` and the
  effect ledger is re-folded equal.
- **AC-R-2.2.2-5** (classification monotonicity): `effective < declared` refused at
  append; `unknown`/absent declared attributes project to the most dangerous class; a
  `readOnlyHint`-declared effect with `effective = irreversible` is ledgered at the
  raised class.
- **AC-R-2.2.2-7** (key stability): `idempotency_key` byte-identical across store
  reopen and across attempts; differs for a different `args_canonical_hash`; `prepared`
  refuses a mismatched key.
- **AC-R-2.2.2-10** (write-ahead barrier): `action.tool.started` for a tool call with a
  non-`read_only` effect in a pre-`committed` phase is refused `NotCommitted`; a helper
  `exec` without a valid `CommitToken` is refused; `read_only` effects may reach
  `observed` without `committed`.
- **AC-R-2.2.3-2** (checkpoint equivalence): `checkpoint(run)` over the raw prefix and
  over a materialized blob yield equal `view_hash`; `restore` plans from either source
  are byte-identical.

## Plan
1. `hh-ontology::risk` — `RiskClass{reversibility, repeat_safety, scope}`, the closed
   axes (`RiskReversibility` danger-ordered `read_only < reversible < compensable <
   irreversible`; `RiskScope{workspace_local, external}`), `max_by_danger`, `UNKNOWN`.
   `RepeatSafety` moves here (its sum is carried verbatim into the risk class — CC1);
   `hh-hir::kinds` re-exports it and gains `project_risk(&EffectAttributes)` (the
   §5a.2 projection: `reversibility' = read_only if mutability = read_only else
   reversibility`; `scope = workspace_local iff world = closed`; `repeat_safety`
   verbatim; absent attributes ⇒ `UNKNOWN`).
2. `hh-ledger::effect` — `EffectPhase`/`ObservedOutcome`/`ProbeVerdict`, `EffectFold`
   (the rebuildable per-effect record), `fold_event` (lenient, used by rebuild/commit),
   `validate_event` (strict, used by append): phase transitions, payload requirements
   (`effective_risk_class` on `intended`; `idempotency_key`/`baseline_ref`/
   `compensation_plan_id` gates on `prepared`; `attempt_no` sequencing; `fencing_token`
   == live generation post-`prepared`; `outcome`/`verdict`/`cause` enums; escalation
   ref on `abandoned`; dual-form `compensated`/`reverted`), `idempotency_key`
   derivation, `CommitToken` + `validate_commit_token` (`NotCommitted`/`Fenced`),
   `commit_effect` (write-ahead helper — idempotent re-commit and stored-observation
   return), `effect_state`/`effects_in_state`.
3. `hh-ledger::classes` — `probed`/`compensated`/`reverted` register as `Effect`
   closers; `effect::scope_close_fires(class, payload, fold)` is the one conditional
   predicate consulted by append-validation, the commit fold and the checkpoint view
   (CC1): `observed{partial}`, `probed{undeterminable}` and a retryable
   `…{not_applied}` leave the scope open; the `compensated`/`reverted` marker form
   omits `scope.effect_id`. `control.retry.{scheduled,fired,skipped}` and
   `control.timeout.fired` registered.
4. `hh-ledger::store` — `RunState.effects` fold (rebuild + commit + batch validation);
   `check_scopes`/`apply_scope_marks` consult the fold-aware close predicate; `append`
   runs the effect validator and the I-1 `action.tool.started` gate.
5. `hh-ledger::views` + `recovery` — `ViewKind::EffectLedger`/`CheckpointView`;
   `Store::checkpoint`, `Store::restore` (acquire/takeover → verify → checkpoint →
   recovery table → one `resumed` → ledgered actions → plan), `Store::retry_due`.
6. `hh-budget` — the tree tracks per-effect risk; `exhaust` blocks only on open
   non-`read_only` effects (closes DF-S1.6-1).
7. Tests: unit (machine/projection/key), integration (ledger lifecycle + recovery +
   budget exemption). Every new behavior has a removal-sensitive test.
8. ADR-0238 (S1.7 owned decisions + interim rulings), deferral flip, closeout docs.
